preview.install.summary.comment: Field label in the summary of a Python wheel (.whl) file: the one-line description the package author wrote in the wheel's METADATA. Not formatted; the value that follows is the author's own text. Python, wheel and METADATA stay as they are. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.

preview.install.requiresPython.comment: Field label in the summary of a Python wheel (.whl) file: the Python versions the package says it works with, followed by the author's version condition written exactly as stored, for example >=3.8. Not formatted. Python stays as it is. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.

preview.install.dependencies.comment: Field label in the summary of a Python wheel (.whl) file: the other packages this one says it needs, listed one requirement per line exactly as the author wrote them (name, version condition, optional extras). Not formatted. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.

preview.install.license.comment: Field label in the summary of a Python wheel (.whl) file: the license the author declared, usually an SPDX identifier such as MIT, shown exactly as stored. It is a statement by the author, not a check by the app. Not formatted. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.

preview.install.wheelVersion.comment: Field label in the summary of a Python wheel (.whl) file: the version of the wheel file format the archive follows (the Wheel-Version entry of its WHEEL file), a number such as 1.0. It is not the version of the package. Wheel stays as it is. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.
preview.install.wheelVersion.ja: Wheel 形式のバージョン

preview.install.generator.comment: Field label in the summary of a Python wheel (.whl) file: the packaging tool that built the file and its version, shown as the tool wrote it, for example bdist_wheel (0.43.0). Not formatted. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.
preview.install.generator.ja: ビルドに使用したツール

preview.install.pureLibrary.comment: Field label in the summary of a Python wheel (.whl) file with a yes or no value: yes when the wheel declares that it holds plain Python code only (its Root-Is-Purelib entry), no when it declares compiled, platform-specific parts. It is the wheel's own declaration; the app does not verify it. Python stays as it is. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.
preview.install.pureLibrary.ja: 純粋な Python ライブラリ

preview.install.tags.comment: Field label in the summary of a Python wheel (.whl) file: the compatibility tags that say which Python versions, interpreters and platforms the wheel is built for, for example py3-none-any. The tags are shown exactly as stored and are never translated. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.

preview.install.commands.comment: Field label in the summary of a Python wheel (.whl) file: the names of the commands the package would add to the terminal when installed (its console and graphical entry points). Only the names are listed, as stored; nothing is run. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.
preview.install.commands.ja: インストールされるコマンド

preview.install.startupFiles.comment: Field label in the summary of a Python wheel (.whl) file: the paths of the .pth files (Python path configuration files) that installing the wheel would place where every Python start reads them. A line in such a file that begins with import is run by Python at each start; the lines are not shown here. The file extension .pth stays as it is. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.
preview.install.startupFiles.ja: インストールされるパスファイル（.pth）

preview.install.installedScripts.comment: Field label in the summary of a Python wheel (.whl) file: the files the wheel keeps in its scripts folder, which installation copies into the environment's command folder. File names are shown as stored. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.
preview.install.installedScripts.ja: インストールされるスクリプト

preview.install.nativeModules.comment: Field label in the summary of a Python wheel (.whl) file with a count: how many files in the wheel are compiled machine code (shared libraries and extension modules recognized by name or by their first bytes) rather than Python source. Shown only when the count is above zero. The count is formatted by the app for the display locale. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.
preview.install.nativeModules.ja: ネイティブモジュール
